description: A full-width wrapper (mj-wrapper) that groups whole sections under one background.

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the background colour (background-color).

members.name: BackgroundUrl
members.description: Gets or sets the background image URL (background-url).

members.name: Border
members.description: Gets or sets the border shorthand (border).

members.name: BorderRadius
members.description: Gets or sets the border radius (border-radius).

members.name: FullWidth
members.description: Gets or sets whether the wrapper spans the full width (full-width).

members.name: Sections
members.description: Gets the sections held by the wrapper.

members.name: TextAlign
members.description: Gets or sets the text alignment (text-align).
